whatIsWrong.counterEvidence2: no deduplication of those 18 records yields 2: dedupe by uuid gives 18, dedupe by name gives 3 (MAIN, P1, P2). The sentence 'not a deduplicated page-list length' implies dedupe would give 2; it cannot.

whatIsWrong.counterEvidence4: the restore page table's P1 uuid d224f8d13804e759 does NOT appear among t31's 18 records (only b275cd23... does). So even the P1 entry is not the same page object, which reinforces 'different time', not 'duplicate records'.

defects.text: t31Source.meaning, judgment.why18IsDifferent and check 5 describe t31's 18 pages as 'MAIN + 16 duplicate P1 records + P2' and as 'not a deduplicated page-list length'. The 18 records have 18 distinct uuids and come from getAllSchematicPagesInfo() (t31-overlap-classify.mjs L62), the same call t53 uses. No dedupe gives 2 (by uuid 18, by name 3). The true relation is the same metric at two times, with 16 probe pages created in between.

judgment.choice is the single letter 'a' (可证). It is scoped in label/whyA/notB and in overall 'a-artifact-provable-live-unproven', but a reader quoting the letter alone would say 'pages=2 可证', which contradicts the guide. The two-level answer does not fit a one-letter field.

no committed script writes main-restore-verify.json (t52-main-restore.mjs writes main-restore-<batch>-<ts>.json), so how its pages array was produced cannot be verified. r7t5's caution 'NOT a live dmt_... call' is therefore warranted, though the {u,n}+active shape looks like a live capture.

overall.why: The judged conclusion is defensible and honestly bounded: pages=2 is countable inside the committed restore artifact, is NOT live-provable, and belongs to the same restore event as 21=63-42 (item 4 is the strongest part of the artifact, and stronger than r7t1 on that point). No number was rewritten; the letter 'a' is scoped by liveProvable:false and the overall label. It is therefore NOT a case of turning unprovable into provable to close out. But the reason it publishes for why 18 differs from 2 is false in three places, and falsifiable with one command: 18 distinct uuids from the same API call t53 uses, and no dedupe yields 2. That is a medium-severity factual defect in exactly the area under review.
